name: OpenAPI Specification
summary: Vendor-neutral, JSON/YAML-encoded interface description language for HTTP APIs: an OpenAPI description declares servers, paths, operations, parameters, request/response bodies and security schemes, using (since 3.1) full JSON Schema 2020-12 for data models.

level_notes.1: Defined by the OpenAPI Initiative (Linux Foundation) specification documents published at spec.openapis.org; the Markdown sources in OAI/OpenAPI-Specification are authoritative and the published JSON Schemas for each minor version are normative companions (non-authoritative for validation). Companion specs Arazzo (workflows) and Overlay (document transformation) are also OAI standards.
level_notes.0: No reference implementation. The OAI-published JSON Schemas validate OpenAPI documents; widely used parsers/validators are swagger-parser (Java), kin-openapi (Go), openapi-spec-validator (Python), Spectral (linting) and openapi-generator (code generation). oasdiff detects breaking changes between versions.
level_notes.2: learn.openapis.org is the official OAI tutorial site; swagger.io's 'OpenAPI Guide' is the long-standing vendor tutorial.
